title: Ron Hell: Maria is a natural Asian-African hybrid
summary: David Ron Hell tells of Ron Hell: Maria is a natural Asian-African hybrid, about 250,000 years ago to 1,700 years ago at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: My hypothesis is that Maria is a hybrid but natural.

plain: David Ron Hell, a researcher speaking on a podcast with host Jesse Michels about small three-fingered mummified bodies said to come from Peru, gives his view on one of them, called Maria. He says his hypothesis is that Maria is a hybrid, but a natural one, a mix of Asian and African lineages rather than something made. If true, it would mean these strange bodies have an earthly, if unusual, origin.
